mapper.sql: staff_loans.id AS id, staff_loans.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, employees.gender AS gender, departments.name AS departmentName, staff_loans.position_id AS positionId, positions.name AS positionName, staff_loans.payback_period AS paybackPeriod, staff_loans.payback_date AS paybackDate, staff_loans.amount AS amount, staff_loans.created AS created, staff_loans.modified AS modified, CONCAT(user1.first_name, ' ', user1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(user2.first_name, ' ', user2.last_name) AS modifiedBy, staff_loans.status AS status

FROM staff_loans INNER JOIN employees ON staff_loans.employee_id = employees.id LEFT JOIN departments ON departments.id = employees.department_id AND departments.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN positions ON staff_loans.position_id = positions.id LEFT JOIN users AS user1 ON staff_loans.created_by = user1.id LEFT JOIN users AS user2 ON staff_loans.modified_by = user2.id

WHERE staff_loans.status > 0
AND ( CAST(staff_loans.employee_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR CAST(staff_loans.position_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR employees.code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR employees.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR employees.name_kh LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR departments.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR positions.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
